_comment: Declarative params for the deliberately-dumb first strategy (§5). HASH-LOCKED by core/config (§15). Strict parameter budget (1-2 params) — this strategy's only job is to exercise the pipeline end-to-end. If it looks profitable, suspect the harness before believing in edge. Pairs/timeframe/fee tier are confirmed with the operator at ORIENT (§7) before backtest.
name: ema_cross
_venue_note: Trading venue = bitbank (JFSA-registered, ADR 0002 + Findings). Chosen 2026-06-27: ccxt has no Binance Japan entity, and bitbank is the only ccxt JFSA venue with OHLCV support. Binance Global remains viewing-only and never feeds this strategy.
_pairs_note: ORIENT: BTC/JPY, 1h (bitbank's primary BTC quote is JPY; confirmed listed+active via ccxt). StaticPairlist for reproducibility (§8.8). Fees from bitbank's published spot schedule (config/backtest/costs.json); operator confirms their tier before real capital (§8.3/§14).
